notes.title: Color By 1.1 REVAMP!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/5b0zj1kc5qwh2sl/ColorByBanner800x400_3.png

What’s New in 1.1?


 Revamped intro to intermediate levels: Virtually all new in the first half of the game!
 Smoothed out difficulty progression: Teaches and inspires you to step into the harder puzzles!
 Early Guidance Tips: Creates awareness of puzzles concepts!
 Co-Op Game Mode: Play with a friend to solve special two-player puzzles!
 Challenge Mode Puzzles: Beyond the hardest levels, these are for those who are not feint of heart!
 Official Player’s Manual: Provides the details of every aspect of the game including the lore of Color By written by Tim Ahrens, author of the fantasy book The Salvation of Tanlegalle

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE: More fun and new challenges!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/9isv2ndt1bmvvx4/ColorByBanner800x400_2.png
We’re creating an update for Color By to add even more fun and challenges for you! Our new version will have:
•	Overhauled guidance of gameplay/mechanics and new reference guide
•	Earlier introduction of key mechanics
•	Reworked level progression with polished/rearranged/replaced levels
•	More puzzles using interlocked, revised mechanics
•	Co-op DLC

MEET THE COLOR BY CREATORS
Stop by our booth at the  Let’s Play Gaming Expo in Plano, Texas -- June 18-19, 2016 

ADD TO WISHLIST
Add Color By to your wishlist so that you’ll receive all our upcoming special announcements!
